prompt:
Two input images with STRICTLY DIFFERENT ROLES.
IMAGE 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the white engineering comparison drawing of two kettle charcoal grills. Preserve its full composition, black technical ink, restrained hatching, gray construction guides, section indications, plan views, every Spanish label, correct coal and food placement, white background and original red heat-direction arrows.
IMAGE 2 is ONLY A STROKE STYLE REFERENCE: look specifically at the thin red hand-drawn flame outlines around/behind the bull's shoulders and head. Borrow ONLY that flame linework style. Do not copy the bull, typography, layout, branding, text, cream paper, shading density or any other content.

Requested edit: remove the dark red filled/brushy blobs on the charcoal in IMAGE 1 and replace them with airy RED OUTLINE FLAMES like the fine pen-drawn flames in IMAGE 2. Graceful elongated irregular flame tongues, delicate pointed tips, sinuous hand-drawn contour lines, occasional nested broken contour inside, WHITE EMPTY interiors. Not solid red silhouettes, not heavy brush strokes, not red smudges. Use muted warm brick red with lightly varying pressure; thin enough to resemble spontaneous red-pencil or fineliner annotations but clearly discernible at the full sheet size.
Create one small lively cluster of about 4–6 thin outlined flame tongues arising from the central charcoal pile on the left, and a smaller cluster of 3–4 tongues above each side charcoal basket on the right. Let them rise into the empty space between the coal bed and the cooking grate, stopping well below food and never reaching the grate. Vary their curves and heights organically. Keep outlines sparse and airy, with no glow, haze, smoke, yellow/orange, heavy saturation or photorealism.
Restore most charcoal faces to original black/white ink; a few fine red crack accents are enough. The existing geometrically precise red heat ARROWS must remain unchanged and distinguishable from the loose artistic flame outlines. No flames under the center drip pan, no new coals, no flames around the outside apparatus. Small plan views unchanged. This is a controlled red pen flourish on a sober mechanical drawing. Do not add a legend or any text.
